title: control-room shapes
description: The shapes control-room's answers share: a product, a pull request, a card and the rest, each written once so every answer that holds one means the same by it (G-GIT-12). The document itself takes one of each, so its sample shows them.

checkoutStatus.description: A checkout's branch and how far it is from its upstream, as git knows it without fetching.

ahead.description: Commits the checkout has that its upstream does not: work not pushed yet.

behind.description: Commits its upstream has that the checkout does not: a checkout to bring up to date.

branch.description: The branch the checkout is on, so the owner sees a checkout left on a pull request's branch.

upstream.description: The branch it tracks, empty when it tracks none, so a branch that tracks the wrong one shows.

column.description: One column and how many cards it holds.

count.description: How many cards the column holds now, so the page can show where work piles up.

id.description: The column's id on its board, as kanban names it, so a reader can match a card's column to it.

label.description: The column's label as the board shows it, for people.

connection.description: Whether control-room can read GitHub, as last checked.

account.description: The GitHub login the token belongs to, read at its last check; empty before the first check.

checked_at.description: When the token was last checked with GitHub, so a stale check shows.

connected.description: Whether the read token was checked and works, so every GitHub fact can say why it is missing when it is not.

expires_at.description: When the token expires, as GitHub said at its check; absent when it does not say, so the owner renews it in time.

from.description: Where the token is kept, or would be: the Keychain item, the Secret Service item, the file.

gap.description: Why the connection could not be read.

managed.description: The variable naming the file the token is read from, when it is kept outside the control room.

read_only.description: Whether the token can only read, as control-room asks: a token that can write is never used to read.

design.description: One design: its blocks, its releases (the product's MVPs, G-PLAN-9) and its open findings.

blocks.description: How many blocks the design holds, a measure of how far it is drawn.

err.description: Why this design could not be read, naming what failed.

id.description: The design's id, its folder's name under .designer/.

open.description: How many questions, risks and contradictions are still open in it (G-PLAN-11), the design work left.

releases.description: The design's releases, the product's MVPs in order (G-PLAN-9): its roadmap.

source.description: The command that shows it by hand.

designRoot.description: The designs in a project's .designer/ root, "no design" when it holds none, or why they could not be read.

err.description: Why the read failed, naming what failed; a failure is never shown as no design.

gap.description: Why there is nothing to read, such as no design or no checkout; empty when the root was read.

list.description: Each design in the root, in e-designer's order.

source.description: The command that read it, so a person can read the same by hand (every number control-room shows links to where it can be checked by hand).

epicProblem.description: A problem the Epics page flags: what is wrong, the pull request or card it is about, the product, epic and feature it is under when known, and where the Epics page shows it.

epic.description: The epic it is under, when known, to find it on the Epics page.

feature.description: The feature it is under, when known, to find it on the Epics page.

page.description: Where it shows on the Epics page, so the owner finds it there.

repo.description: The pull request's repository, said when no product holds it.

text.description: What is wrong, in words, for the owner to fix.

url.description: The pull request or card it is about, on GitHub or on its card page.

facet.description: One column's filter: its key and label, how many of its values are kept, and each value with how many items it would show.

key.description: The filter's key, as the address and the flags name it.

label.description: Its label, as the page shows it.

on.description: How many of its values the query keeps, so the page shows the filter is on.

options.description: Each value it can keep, with how many items it would show.

facetOption.description: One value of a filter, with how many items it would show with the other filters kept.

label.description: Its label, as the page shows it.

n.description: How many items it would show with the other filters as they are.

on.description: Whether the query keeps it now.

value.description: The value, as the address and the flags take it.

feature.description: One feature an epic card lists: its id and what it does.

id.description: The feature's id, unique across the org (G-CARD-2): the id a card's feature:<id> tag and a pull request's label name.

what.description: What the feature does, in the epic card's own words, for people.

focus.description: The focused epic, the one every page puts first: its key, its title, and where its card is.

product.description: The product whose board holds its card.

outlawBranch.description: A branch ahead of its repository's default branch, with no open pull request, whose name names no known feature.

base.description: The default branch it is ahead of.

behind.description: Commits of the default branch it lacks.

err.description: Why GitHub could not compare it; it is listed as not known, never left out.

last_commit.description: When its last commit was made, so an old branch shows as old; the zero time 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z when not known.

product.description: The product whose repository holds the branch.

reasons.description: Why it is an outlaw, each in words, such as its name names no known feature.

unrelated.description: Whether GitHub could not compare it with the default branch: they share no history, or it was deleted after it was listed.

outlawCard.description: A card in progress or in review, not an epic card, with no epic or no feature tag, and the epic it belongs to as far as known: its epic tag's, or its feature's.

agent.description: The agent that wrote it, empty when a person did (G-CARD-12).

branch.description: The git branch its work happens on, its pull request's head.

column.description: The column it is in, by its label.

created.description: When it was made, so an old card shows as old.

depends_on.description: The ids of the cards it waits on, its step order.

done.description: Whether it is in its board's done column.

done_at.description: When it reached the done column; empty when not known.

epic.description: The epic it belongs to as far as known: its epic tag's, or its feature's.

features.description: An epic card's features in order.

id.description: The card's id on its board.

in_progress.description: Whether it is being worked: in the board's In Progress or Review column.

key.description: An epic card's key, empty for another kind.

product.description: The product whose board holds the card.

reasons.description: Why it is an outlaw, each in words, such as no #feature:<id> tag.

tags.description: Its tags as kanban wrote them.

turn.description: Whose turn the card says it is, as kanban writes it.

yours.description: Whether it waits for the owner: its turn is the owner's.

outlawPullRequest.description: An open pull request with no epic or no feature label, and the epic it belongs to as far as known: its epic label's, or its feature's.

epic.description: The epic it belongs to as far as known: its epic label's, or its feature's.

product.description: The product whose repository holds it.

reasons.description: Why it is an outlaw, each in words, such as no feature:<id> label.

outlawQuery.description: What the address or the flags ask for: one kind, one product and one epic, each empty for all. A branch belongs to no epic, so asking for an epic leaves out every branch.

epic.description: The one epic kept; empty keeps all.

kind.description: The one kind kept (pull requests, branches, cards, problems); empty keeps all.

product.description: The one product kept; empty keeps all.

outlawReport.description: Every outlaw and problem, what could not be read, and the products they are of.

branches.description: The branches ahead of their default branch, with no open pull request, whose name names no known feature.

cards.description: The cards in progress or in review with no epic or no feature tag.

connected.description: Whether GitHub is connected; when it is not, no pull request, branch or label is read.

err.description: Why no repository's labels could be read.

gaps.description: Sources that could not be read, or only in part.

org.description: The org the repositories are in.

problems.description: What the Epics page flags, each with where it shows there.

products.description: Every product read, the ones a filter may name.

prs.description: The open pull requests with no epic or no feature label.

prs_gap.description: Why no open pull request could be read; then neither are the outlaw pull requests and branches.

query.description: The filter this report was cut to.

tags_cut.description: The products whose board shows kanban cut the cards' tags after their colon: then no card's epic: or feature: tag is read, and every card there counts as having no epic and no feature.

prCheck.description: One job of a pull request's CI, named as GitHub shows it on the pull request.

name.description: The job's name, as GitHub shows it on the pull request.

state.description: The job's state in words: passing, failing, running, queued or skipped, so each failing check can be found.

url.description: The job's log on GitHub, to see why it failed.

prSize.description: How big a pull request is.

product.description: One row: a product by its ID and where each of its parts stands.

board.description: Its board's card counts per column.

checkout.description: Its local checkout and its git status.

ci.description: The latest Actions run of a push to its main branch.

id.description: The product's ID, which never changes (G-PLAN-12).

installed.description: The version installed on this machine, as hubman found it.

kind.description: Hubman's kind for it, "planned" for a product with no release yet, or not in the catalog.

latest.description: The latest release, when hubman could look it up.

release.description: Its latest release and where it was read.

repo.description: Its repository as owner/name; empty when nobody says.

productBoard.description: A product board's card counts per column.

columns.description: Each column with its card count, in the board's order.

err.description: Why the read failed, naming what failed; a failure is never shown as no board.

gap.description: Nothing to read: no repo, no checkout, no board.

open.description: Cards neither done nor in review.

source.description: The command that read it, so a person can read the same by hand (every number control-room shows links to where it can be checked by hand).

waiting.description: Cards in review, waiting for the owner's acceptance.

err.description: Why the read failed, naming what failed; a failure is never shown as no checkout.

gap.description: Nothing to read: no repo, no checkout.

others.description: More checkouts of the same repo.

path.description: The checkout's folder, found under the configured roots.

source.description: The command that read it, so a person can read the same by hand (every number control-room shows links to where it can be checked by hand).

status.description: Its branch and how far it is from its upstream; null when it was not read.

productRelease.description: The latest release and where it was read.

from.description: Where the release was read: GitHub, or the git tags of the checkout.

gap.description: Why there is no release to show, such as no tags; empty when one was read.

source.description: Where it was read: its GitHub page, or the git command that listed the tags.

pullRequest.description: A pull request: an open one waiting for the owner, or one closed lately.

pullRequestFields.description: The fields every pull request shape holds, left open so a shape that adds its own closes them with unevaluatedProperties.

approved_at.description: When its latest approval was given, when its review is approved; the zero time 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z otherwise.

approved_by.description: Who gave its latest approval, when its review is approved.

author.description: Who opened it, by GitHub login, so the owner's own and the machine user's work tell apart.

base.description: The branch it merges into, so a stack of pull requests shows.

branch.description: The branch it merges, whose name ends in its feature (G-CARD-6).

checks.description: The jobs of each workflow's latest run, by name; absent when they could not be read.

ci.description: Its CI state in words: passing, failing, running, no checks or not read, so a failing pull request is not approved by mistake.

closed_at.description: When a closed pull request was closed; absent for an open one.

conflict.description: Whether GitHub says it cannot merge cleanly into its base, so the owner sees it needs work first.

created.description: When it was opened, for the approval order: oldest first. control-room writes the zero time 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z when it does not know.

dismissed.description: True when a reviewer's last verdict was an approval that new commits dismissed.

draft.description: Whether it is a draft: work in progress, never for approval (G-CARD-11).

epics.description: The ids of its epic:<id> labels, in GitHub's order: the work it belongs to.

expedite.description: True for urgent work outside every epic: it carries the expedite label, or its branch ends in /expedite.

features.description: The ids of its feature:<id> labels: the feature of the epic it builds.

gap.description: Why the review or the CI could not be read; review and ci then say "not read".

head_repo.description: The repository its branch lives in: another one for a pull request from a fork.

links.description: The pull requests and issues its description names, as owner/repo#number, so related work shows beside it.

merged.description: Whether a closed pull request was merged; false for an open one.

needs.description: The pull requests its description says it needs first ("depends on", "needs", "after", "blocked by"...), as owner/repo#number, so the approval order puts them before it.

number.description: The pull request's number in its repository.

review.description: Its review state in words: approved, changes requested or no review, so the owner sees whose move it is.

size.description: The files changed and the lines added and removed; absent when they could not be read.

title.description: Its title, as GitHub shows it.

url.description: Its page on GitHub, so every row links to its source (every number control-room shows links to where it can be checked by hand).

run.description: The latest Actions run of a push to the main branch, or why there is none.

conclusion.description: How the run ended (success, failure, cancelled ...), or its status while it runs (such as in progress), so a broken main branch shows.

gap.description: Why there is no run to show, such as no workflow; empty when one was read.

workflow.description: The workflow's name, to tell the runs of one repository apart.

setting.description: One key of config.yaml as it is now: its value, where the value came from, and what it is. A list's value is written as a YAML flow list, the form `config set` takes it in.

help.description: What the setting is for, in a line, so the Settings page and `config show` explain it.

key.description: The setting's key in config.yaml, the name `config get` and `config set` take.

list.description: True when the value is a YAML list, such as roots: `config set` then takes '[a, b]'.

restart.description: True when a running serve takes a new value only when it starts again.

source.description: Where the value comes from: file when config.yaml sets it, default when it does not, so the owner knows what to change.

value.description: The value in use, as config.yaml writes it, or the default when the file does not set it.

catalog_gap.description: Why hubman's catalog could not be read.

focus.description: The epic the owner works on first, read with the boards; null when none.

gaps.description: Sources that could not be read at all.

github.description: Whether GitHub is connected, and with which token.

org.description: The org the products are in, from the config.

owner.description: The owner's name as a card's turn says it, from the config: the cards that wait for them.

products.description: Every product of hubman's catalog and the config, in the catalog's order, and where each part of it stands.

taken.description: When the snapshot was made from the parts the connectors read.

waiting.description: What waits for the owner, most pressing first.
What waits for the owner, most pressing first.

closed.description: The org's pull requests closed lately, the last closed first; read only when a query asks for them.

closed_gap.description: Why the closed pull requests could not be read; empty when they were or were not asked for.

in_review.description: The cards in a Review column: each waits for the owner's acceptance.

prs.description: The open pull requests, in approval order.

prs_gap.description: Why no open pull request could be read; empty when they were.

repo_gaps.description: Why one repository's pull requests could not be listed, by repository; a repository missing from it was read.

your_turn.description: The open cards whose turn is the owner's, those in Review left out, so nothing waits twice.

waitingCard.description: A card on a board, with the command that shows it.

column.description: The column it is in, by its label.

id.description: The card's id on its board.

product.description: The product whose board holds it.

source.description: The command that shows it in full, for a person to run.

tags.description: Its tags as kanban wrote them.

turn.description: Whose turn the card says it is.

workList.description: The report cut to a query: the rows it keeps in its order, how many of how many, the filters with their counts, and what could not be read.

connected.description: Whether GitHub is connected; when it is not, no pull request, branch or label is read.

facets.description: Each filter, with its values and their counts.

gaps.description: Sources that could not be read, or only in part: never counted as nothing.

org.description: The org the repositories are in.

products.description: Every product read, the ones a filter may name.

query.description: The query this list was cut to.

rows.description: The items the query keeps, in its order.

shown.description: How many rows the query keeps.

tags_cut.description: The products whose board shows kanban cut the cards' tags after their colon: their cards count as having no epic and no feature.

total.description: How many items there are before the query, so the page says what it left out.

untimed.description: Items the time window left out because when they changed is not known.

workQuery.description: What the address or the flags ask of the list: words to search for, the values each filter keeps (several at once; none keeps all), a time window, and a sort.

epics.description: The epics kept; expedite for the expedite lane, none for no epic.

features.description: The features kept; none for no feature.

from.description: The first day kept, YYYY-MM-DD, when the window is custom.

kinds.description: The kinds kept: pull requests, branches, cards.

products.description: The products kept; empty keeps all.

q.description: Words every kept item holds in its name, product, epic, feature or branch.

sort.description: The column the list is sorted by, by its key; -key sorts it the other way.

states.description: The states kept; empty keeps all.

to.description: The last day kept, YYYY-MM-DD, when the window is custom.

turns.description: Whose turns are kept; empty keeps all.

when.description: The time window kept: today, 24h, 7d, 30d or custom.

workRow.description: One item as the list shows it, as of when it was read.

at.description: When it last changed, as far as known; at_what says which change it is.

at_what.description: Which change at is: opened, approved, last commit or created.

branch.description: Its branch: a pull request's, a branch's own name, a card's branch field.

checks.description: An open pull request's checks, each with its state.

ci.description: An open pull request's CI state in words.

epics.description: Its epics' and features' ids: a pull request's labels, a branch's feature named by its name and that feature's epic, a card's tags. Empty is none.

expedite.description: True for work in the expedite lane: a pull request labelled expedite, a card tagged #expedite, a branch whose name ends in /expedite.

features.description: Its features: a pull request's feature labels, a branch's feature, a card's feature tags.

kind.description: The item's kind: a pull request, a branch or a card.

name.description: What the list shows for it, linked to url.

ref.description: How the item is named across sources: owner/repo#number for a pull request, owner/repo:branch for a branch, product/card-id for a card.

repo.description: The repository it is in, as owner/name.

state.description: Its state in words: a pull request's review and CI, "no PR" for a branch, a card's column.

sub.description: A second line under its name, such as a pull request's draft mark.

turn.description: Whose move it is, grouped: the owner, an agent, someone else.

url.description: Its page: on GitHub for a pull request or a branch, the card's page for a card.

when.description: How long ago it last changed, in short words such as 2h ago, for the list.

when_title.description: What changed and when, in full, such as opened Fri 30 Oct 2026 09:00, for the hover text.

whose.description: Whose move it is, in the source's own words.

whose_note.description: The source's own words about whose move it is, when they say more than turn.
